waf_block_expression_template: (http.host eq "HOST_APROVADO" and (not ssl or http.request.method ne "POST" or http.request.uri.path ne "/ingest" or http.request.uri.query ne ""))
waf_rate_expression_template: (http.host eq "HOST_APROVADO" and http.request.uri.path eq "/ingest" and http.request.method eq "POST")
waf_rate_proposal: 6 requests per 60 seconds per IP, only if supported by actual zone plan; otherwise choose supported reviewed parameters
secret_policy: preserve existing GITHUB_TOKEN; never export, read or print its value
